title: Balanced brackets
prompt:
Read lines from standard input. For each line (empty lines included) decide whether its round, square and curly brackets `()`, `[]`, `{}` are balanced; every other character is ignored. Print `OK` for a balanced line. Otherwise print `ERROR at N`, where N is the 1-based position (counting characters from the start of the line, spaces included) of the first problem:
- a closing bracket that does not match the most recently opened bracket still open, or that has nothing to match: N is the position of that closing bracket;
- if the line ends while brackets are still open: N is the position of the most recently opened bracket that is still open.
Print one result per input line. All characters are ASCII.
